defect: The fix only moves a default-constructed (mutex-less) unique_lock in Event::Wait above the triggered_ check, which changes nothing; the check-outside-lock pattern and the lock without a mutex were already in Event.h before this change.
reason: The race pattern and the unowned lock predate the change, and the fix's Event.h edit is behaviourally a no-op (the real Event fix came later in 8d8a553).

defect: The fix moves the mutex lock in LimitedWaitable::Wait/WaitFor before the triggered_ check to close a Notify/Wait race.
reason: This change only moved LimitedWaitable verbatim out of Core/TextureReplacer.cpp into the new header, so the racy check-before-lock code already existed before it.

defect: The fix replaces sprintf(discNumInfo, '') with strcpy and adds a space to silence format warnings.
reason: An empty-format sprintf is well-defined, so the fix is warning cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix restructures D3D11 texture upload to pass initial subresource data to CreateTexture2D/3D (speedup plus an unrelated replacement-off bug).
reason: This change only initialized tex pointers to nullptr and added a staging-copy null check; the fix rewrites the upload path for performance and an unrelated bug, and moves the change's lines verbatim.

defect: The header changed the TextDrawer constructor to TextDrawer(Thin3DContext*) (and made TextStringEntry Win32-only Thin3D) while the non-Win32 draw_text.cpp path still defined TextDrawer() and used GL handles, breaking the Linux/Android build.
reason: The fix (Fix Linux/Android compilation) repairs the build break caused by this change's interface change, which only becomes visible when looking at the non-Win32 implementation in draw_text.cpp.

defect: The fix passes firstvreg >= D0 as the Double flag in VLDMIA/VSTMIA/VLDMDB/VSTMDB instead of a hard-coded false.
reason: The hard-coded false Double argument predates this change, which only renamed parameters and added casts.

defect: CtrlMatrixList::GetColumnText dereferences gpuDebug (gpuDebug->GetGState()) without checking it for null, so the matrix tab crashes when no GPU debug interface exists.
reason: The crash fix adds the !gpuDebug guard to the GetColumnText check that this change introduced, and the change's own GetRowCount null-checks gpuDebug, so the inconsistency is visible in the diff.

defect: The non-Windows GetDirListing looks up getFileListIndex(entry.name) with the bare file name instead of the path relative to the disc root, so it gets wrong or new sector entries for files in subdirectories.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added lookup with path + '/' + entry.name, and the diff shows other getFileListIndex calls taking full paths.

defect: The fix only re-adds 'Incorrect function name' comments to two HLE table entries.
reason: This is a comment-only change with no behavioural effect.

defect: In writeVideoImageWithRange the per-row memcheck address is bufferPtr + frameWidth * bpp, without the row index y, so every row reports the same (wrong) range.
reason: The fix adds the missing y * factor to exactly the ExecMemCheck lines this change added.

defect: The fix re-tunes the message dialog layout (line positions 30/200, text at y=50, scale 0.55).
reason: This is a cosmetic layout adjustment, and the 180 line position it replaces came from an intermediate commit, not from this change.

defect: The fix renames the member isAllowTexture1D to isAllowTexture1D_ in the header and its use in SendDataToShader.
reason: isAllowTexture1D(isAllowTexture1D) in the mem-initializer already initializes the member from the parameter correctly, so the rename is a style change with no behavioural effect.

defect: The fix adds a useBufferedRendering condition before applying framebuffer read in the Vulkan state mapping (in a commit about a double-join crash on exit).
reason: The missing useBufferedRendering check already existed in the previous blend/mask framebuffer-read condition, and this change only swapped that condition for pipelineState_.FramebufferRead().

defect: The fix moves the VR view-matrix computation into UpdateVRViewMatrices and recomputes it per mirroring variant to fix glitches from wrong mirroring.
reason: The mirroring handling it repairs predates this change; the camera-pitch code this change added is carried over unchanged (apart from a later +20 tweak).

defect: The fix adds a fog/depth-write heuristic to the clear-mode depth-write mask (depthMask || !fog || !depthWrite).
reason: The clear-mode depthWrite = depthMask behaviour it adjusts existed before this change, which only moved it into the depth-test branch, and the fix is a game-compatibility heuristic.

defect: The fix changes the default DirectInput button-to-keycode table (A/B, X/Y, L1/L2, thumb buttons) and some right-stick directions to suit the author's controller.
reason: This change transliterated the old mapping (same button assignments as before), and the right-stick code the fix also touches came from later commits, so the fix re-tunes defaults rather than repairing this change's lines.

defect: The EP index range checks use epid > EPMap.size() instead of >=, so epid == size passes and EPMap[epid] is read out of bounds.
reason: The fix changes exactly these three off-by-one checks that this change added.

defect: TestBoundingBoxThrough culls draws whose vertices lie just past the inclusive scissor X2/Y2 (x <= right, y <= bottom), wrongly dropping draws that still cover the last scissor column or row.
reason: The fix relaxes these comparisons to right + 1 and bottom + 1 in the function this change added; seeing that it is wrong requires knowing that the scissor bounds are inclusive pixel coordinates.

defect: The fix only rewrites the author's comments in the header.
reason: This is a comment-only change.

defect: The fix removes redundant default assignments in the no-ini branch and adds a TODO comment about hashfiles.
reason: The removed defaults duplicate assignments already made at the start of LoadIni, so the removal changes no behaviour.

defect: The fix replaces the erase-inside-range-for loop in __MicBlockingResume with a proper iterator erase idiom.
reason: The erase-while-iterating loop predates this change, which only changed the inner loop counter from u32 to int.

defect: After loading a savestate, audioBuf stays null (it is not saved), yet the new DoState and __MicInputBlocking's new size != numNeedSamples << 1 check skip creating it and call availableAudioBufSize(), dereferencing a null audioBuf.
reason: The fix (Prevents audiobuf from being null pointer) creates audioBuf in the DoState function this change added, and the diff shows the dereference and the 'maybe also need to save audioBuf' note.

defect: The shift == 0 branch passes shift, mask, offset to a format with only two specifiers, so the shader gets mask = shift (0) and offset = mask.
reason: The fix removes the stray shift argument from exactly this WRITE line, a format/argument mismatch visible in the diff.

defect: FindTransferFramebuffers tests srcYOffset >= (u32)-1 instead of != (u32)-1, so srcY is offset by -1 when no source buffer is found and not offset when one is.
reason: The fix corrects this inverted comparison that this change added.

defect: Config::Save calls network->Set('EnableWlan', &bEnableWlan, true), passing the pointer (converted to bool true) with a default, so the user's networking setting is never saved correctly.
reason: The fix changes this added line to Set('EnableWlan', bEnableWlan), and passing a pointer where every other Set passes a value is visible in the diff.

defect: sceWlanDevIsPowerOn and sceWlanGetSwitchState were changed to always return 1 (WLAN on), which broke Peace Walker and other games.
reason: The fix makes these two returns depend on a new option that defaults to off, undoing the game breakage caused by this change's 0 to 1 change; the breakage is only known from runtime behaviour in games.

defect: The fix adds (int) casts to signed/unsigned comparisons in push_back_write and peek to silence compiler warnings.
reason: Both compared values are non-negative, so the comparisons were already correct and the fix is warning cleanup.

defect: The fix casts haystack.size() to int in countChar's loop condition to silence a sign-compare warning.
reason: The loop is correct for any realistic string size, so the fix is warning cleanup.

defect: The fix drops the #ifndef Symbian branch and calls ofstream::open(activeCheatFile.c_str()) on every platform.
reason: The Symbian build failure (ofstream::open taking std::string) predates this change; the change's wrong macro name just failed to fix it and added no new failure.

defect: GetBlockNumberFromEmuHackOp maps an emuhack op back to a block by searching normalEntry over all blocks, including destroyed (invalid) ones, so it can return a stale block.
reason: The fix (bug caused by the recent JIT optimization) skips invalid blocks, searches newest-first and clears normalEntry on destroy, which repairs the lookup this change added; seeing when entries collide requires knowing the JIT's code-space reuse.

defect: sceAtracGetBufferInfoForReseting reports neededBytes = Sampleoffset - first.size without clamping it to first.writableBytes, so it can ask the game to write more data than the buffer allows.
reason: The fix clamps exactly this newly added value to writableBytes, and the two values are computed next to each other in the diff.

defect: The two added 'antialiasing' RectVGradient calls per 1-dp column double the vertices to 24 per step, which overflows the 65536-vertex DrawBuffer (assert) on wide dp resolutions such as 4K at 1:1.
reason: The fix adds a step size that keeps the wave within MAX_VERTS; the overflow became reachable through this change's added calls, but the limit is only visible in DrawBuffer.cpp (the width/step issue for other dps predates it).

defect: Replacing the explicit delete audio with QScopedPointers makes MainAudio and the running QThread get destroyed at the end of main, after NativeShutdown, so their destructors touch emulator internals that are already shut down and Qt crashes on exit.
reason: The fix moves these scoped pointers into mainInternal so they destruct before NativeShutdown, and the diff shows the delete before NativeShutdown being removed.

defect: The depal FBO is rendered with ALL_LAYERS but then bound as a texture with layer 0, so multiview rendering samples the wrong texture view.
reason: The fix changes this newly added layer argument to Draw::ALL_LAYERS; judging it requires the thin3d multiview layer semantics.

defect: sceJpegGetOutputInfo returns 0xC000 on a bad address or bad data, a positive value that games such as God Eater Burst read as a valid buffer size instead of an error.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these two added error returns with getYCbCrBufferSize(0, 0), and a positive magic error value in a function that returns a size is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix makes the common PackFramebufferSync_ read back RGBA8888 and convert on the CPU (with h clamping), as GLES did, instead of asking the backend for the native 16-bit format.
reason: This change moved the D3D11 PackFramebufferSync_/ReadFramebufferToMemory code verbatim into the common class, and Vulkan readback was a no-op before, so the fix ports a feature rather than repairing a defect introduced here.

defect: The fix removes the GLES ConvertFromRGBA8888 and PackFramebufferSync_ bodies and delegates to the common implementation.
reason: On this file the fix is a refactor that moves code into FramebufferManagerCommon, and it repairs nothing in the CopyFramebufferToMemorySync(vfb->fbo, ...) calls this change added.

defect: CopyReadbackBuffer steps the source row pointer by width bytes instead of width * pixelSize while copying width * pixelSize bytes per row, so Vulkan readbacks are garbled.
reason: This change added the memcpy (the old loop copied nothing), which made the wrong source stride take effect, and the fix multiplies the stride by pixelSize; the mismatch is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix adds depal and shader-blend copy counters to the GPU stats string.
reason: On this file the fix only adds new statistics; the format string and arguments this change added were consistent.

defect: The fix makes VertexReader::ReadWeights multiply float weights by 2 to undo a 0.5 scale applied by the decoder.
reason: At this change the decoder stored float weights unscaled, so the memcpy was correct; the half-size bug came from the later Step_WeightsFloat 0.5 scale.
